source.title: 2. Diagnosis and Classification of Diabetes: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026

schema_gaps: No dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind; guideline recommendations are represented as author_conclusion with descriptive tags.

The quantitative-result model is primary-study oriented; ranges and secondary narrative statistics that do not map cleanly to a single estimate are preserved as other atoms rather than forcing artificial numeric structure.
limitations: Cited primary studies were not independently read in this pass; secondary-reported results remain anchored to the ADA chapter.
Full ADA guideline-development methodology is delegated to the separate Introduction and Methodology and is not contained in this chapter.
